entry.name: jit.gl.path
entry.digest: Generate and render a path in OpenGL
entry.description: The jit.gl.path object generates and renders a 3D path. See the jit.path object for more information on the underlying path structure. The 3D visualization can be rendered as either a line, an extruded line (ribbon), an extruded circle (tube), or an extruded 2D contour. The path stores 10 values: position x/y/z, color r/g/b/a, scale x/y, and orient angle. For more information on how the extrusion is handled, see the GLE library: http://www.linas.org/gle
